name: chatgpt-maestro
description: Run ChatGPT (OpenAI) models in Copilot Chat, Claude Code, and Codex without an API key using browser login. Multi-account rotation, quota tracking, and agent coordinator to delegate tasks across all available models.

languageModelTools.name: chatgpt_listAvailableModels
languageModelTools.userDescription: Lists all other language models available in VS Code (Antigravity Maestro, OpenRouter Maestro, Copilot, etc.).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List all language models available in the current VS Code workspace that can be delegated tasks.

languageModelTools.name: chatgpt_delegateTask
languageModelTools.userDescription: Delegates a programming task, code review, or subtask to another available model in VS Code.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delegate a subtask to another available language model in VS Code (such as Claude from Antigravity, Gemini, OpenRouter, Copilot) and receive its completed answer.

targetModelId.description: The model ID to run the task on (e.g. antigravity-maestro/claude-sonnet-5-5-high, openrouter-maestro/..., copilot/gpt-4o).

taskTitle.description: Short summary title of the task.

taskDescription.description: Full prompt and instructions for the assigned model.

languageModelTools.name: chatgpt_coordinatorCreateTask
languageModelTools.userDescription: Creates a task in the local agent coordinator task queue (.agent-coordinator/tasks.json).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a task in the shared agent coordinator task queue for another agent to claim and execute.

languageModelTools.name: chatgpt_coordinatorListTasks
languageModelTools.userDescription: Lists tasks from the local agent coordinator queue.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List open, claimed, blocked, or done tasks in the agent coordinator.

languageModelTools.name: chatgpt_coordinatorUpdateTask
languageModelTools.userDescription: Updates a coordinator task status and result.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Update the status and result of an existing coordinator task.

chatgptMaestro.gateway.port.description: Preferred port for the local gateway that Claude Code and Codex talk to.

chatgptMaestro.gateway.autoStart.description: Start the local gateway automatically when VS Code launches.

chatgptMaestro.browser.path.description: Path to Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome executable for browser login. Leave empty to auto-detect.

chatgptMaestro.browser.headless.description: Run the browser headlessly. Default is false so you can complete sign-in and Cloudflare Turnstile.

chatgptMaestro.quota.autoRefreshMinutes.description: How often to refresh ChatGPT account session and status in the background.

chatgptMaestro.rotation.strategy.description: How to rotate between multiple connected ChatGPT accounts when limits are reached.

chatgptMaestro.rotation.cooldownMinutes.description: Fallback cooldown applied to an account after a rate limit.

chatgptMaestro.rotation.maxWaitSeconds.description: How long a request may wait for a cooling-down account to recover before failing.

chatgptMaestro.saveHistoryInChatGPTWeb.description: Whether to save API conversations into your ChatGPT web chat history sidebar.

chatgptMaestro.claudeCode.settingsScope.description: Where to write Claude Code environment settings.

chatgptMaestro.claudeCode.smallFastModel.description: Model ID used for Claude Code background tasks.

chatgptMaestro.reloadOnModelChange.description: Prompt to reload VS Code after changing models for Claude Code or Codex.

chatgptMaestro.logLevel.description: Minimum log level for the ChatGPT Maestro output channel.
